description: Open one OwnerSpec calculator, prefilled with the user's numbers. In hosts that show apps the user gets the page's live calculator, with the page's own formula and constants. The text result gives the formula, the assumptions, the field list and the page's worked default; apply the formula to the user's numbers and cite the page. Get ids and field names from list_calculators.

calculator.description: Calculator id from list_calculators, e.g. exp-tank, or the page URL

inputs.description: Field name to value, using the field names list_calculators returns (e.g. {"vol": 40, "line": 70})

name: run_calculator
title: Open an OwnerSpec calculator
